status: phase-10 numerical candidate sealed for prospective development 2333 before RF
source_contract: Fixed known-vessel 5.5 mm scored core guard: 40 of 8x16 tissue pixels, 5 mm wide motion guard: 192 of 32x16. No isolated component is an input. Evaluator-only blood/tissue power <=.1 on both; archive IQ for a failure without filter scores.
calibration_contract: Train-only prior tissue angular phase map as in phase 9, 0.4-pixel masked smoothing on the wide 5 mm guard. Last 8 of 16 stationary frames validate wide coherence >=.7 and core-5.5 >=.5 and >=.85 times core train; train minima and bounded noise gain <=4. Map is gate only, regular IQ stays unmodified.
reference_selection: Retain phase-8 mixture-only pre-score loss rule on the new core. Permit its reference choice only if every view has >=.9 fraction of the 5.5 mm core above 0.2 times the median reference amplitude in the wide 5 mm tissue guard. Reference amplitudes derive only from prior calibration. Otherwise use hybrid.
hybrid: Accepted local phase fraction .75 at sigma 4 with minimum validation gain .01, half-strength open nonperiodic unitary IQ transport; the wide fit remains at 5 mm, central scoring core at 5.5 mm.
decision: All four 2333 scenes must pass the same source/calibration and paired SVD, Axis 1, roundtrip, and slow Axis 2 thresholds as phase 10 development. No retuning or reselection after 2333 RF. A failure blocks reserves; a pass remains software simulation evidence, not phantom validation.
